description:
These scenarios pin down audited vulnerabilities so reverts of the fix
  are caught by CI. Scenarios tagged @security-todo capture present-day
  (still-insecure) behaviour and must be tightened when the fix lands.

steps.name: an anonymous viewer sends a GET request to "/api/v1/dev/fill-in"
an anonymous viewer sends a POST request to "/api/v1/dev/fill-in"

steps.name: the current user PATCHes their own profile with JSON body:
the current user fetches their own profile
the response body property "systemRole" should equal "user"

elements.name: Soft-deleting a user invalidates their existing session cookie

steps.name: I delete the current user's account
the current user fetches "/api/v1/users/whoami" with their old cookie

elements.name: Swagger docs are reachable without auth in non-production

steps.name: an anonymous viewer sends a GET request to "/api-docs/auth/openapi.json"
the response status should not be 401
